profile.headline: ENT-Software Engineer-Lead Cons
profile.summary: I've worked as a Software Engineer for about nine years, with the most experience on the backend. In my last role at Twitter, I designed and developed a component for Twitter Business Settings to allow users to associate their accounts with their brands to avoid sharing passwords resulting in a reduction of compromised accounts. For this project, I used Scala and the Finatra framework.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Account Security:
- Migrated the account listing and switcher from twitter.com from the old stack to the new one built with Scala and Finatra to reduce costly maintenance and risks.

Tech Stack: Scala, Finatra, SQL, Git, GitHub, Bazel.

positions.title: Senior Backend Scala Engineer
positions.description:
Account Security:
- Designed and developed a component for Twitter Business Settings to allow users to associate their accounts with their brands to avoid sharing passwords resulting in a reduction of compromised accounts. For this project, I used Scala and the Finatra framework.
- Participated in the development of the new login feature, which reduced the number of compromised accounts and simplified the investigation of compromised accounts. The project was built with Scala and Finatra.

Tech Stack: Scala, Finatra, SQL, Git, GitHub, Bazel.

positions.title: ENT-Software Engineer-Cons II
positions.description:
Discovery Data Domain Expert:
 - Created a microservice to retrieve customer information from downstream services using Scala and Play Framework, which quickly provided a quote offer without requesting any extra details from the customer.

Tech Stack: Scala, Play Framework, Pivotal Cloud Foundry, Swagger, Open API Specification v2, Git, GitHub, Jenkins, SBT.

positions.title: SOFTWARE ENGINIEER
positions.locationName: 651 Davis St San Francisco, CA 94111 United States of America
positions.description:
Kernel (Platform Team):
 - Developed an authorization layer with Apigee and following the OAuth 2.0. standard, to grant access to external and internal applications for consuming enterprise services, which allowed developers to focus more on business logic.

 - Created library to perform calls to GraphQL servers over HTTP using Scala and Play WS, which helped developers avoid manual serializations for queries, mutations and responses.

 - Created library to retrieve HashiCorp Vault secrets and save those into the cache, based on the expiration time, using Scala and Play WS, which helped avoid code duplication.

Discovery Team:
 - Delivered a RESTful service to retrieve customer information from a third-party vendor with Scala and Play Framework, which helped speed up the latency from 1 second to 100 milliseconds and reduce the number of calls lowering prices.

Tech Stack: Scala, Play Framework, Ehcache Pivotal Cloud Foundry, Swagger, Open API Specification v2, Apigee, Git, Bitbucket, MongoDB.

positions.title: Senior Developer
positions.description:
Media API Team:
- Built a RESTful service with C#, ASP. NET Web API and Amazon S3 to store documents from applications inside the whole organization, which allowed developers to focus more on business logic.

Sales API Team:                                                                                                            
 - Implemented unit tests on various RESTful services with C#, which helped detect code errors before pushing those into the environment.

Tech Stack: C#, ASP. NET Web API, Swagger, Open API Specification v2, Git, Bitbucket, MongoDB.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
Woodfin:
 - Created an asynchronous messaging component to sync information between two applications using C#, WCF and Azure Queues, which sync a high volume of data without impacting any systems.

Tech Stack: C#, Windows Communication Foundation, Azure Queues, Team Foundation Server, Microsoft SQL Server.

company.name: Bufete de Tecnología y Soluciones Avanzadas, S.C.

positions.title: Semi Senior Developer
positions.description:
Junta de Conciliación y Arbitraje:
 - Created a module for registering employee claims against employers with C#, Windows Forms, WCF, and Microsoft SQL Server, which increased government employee’s efficiency.

Tech Stack: C#, .NET Framework 4.0, Windows Forms, Windows Communication Foundation, Team Foundation Server, Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle.

positions.title: Developer
positions.description:
Ordenes de Aprehensión:
 - Created a module for maintaining policy orders to capture criminals with C#, Windows Forms, WCF, and Oracle, which reduced the government employee's redundant manual labor.

Fiscalia:
 - Developed a module for registering crime reports with C#, Windows Forms, WCF, and Oracle. After completion, it autogenerated following up documents based on the crime, which increased the number of reported cases.

Tech Stack: C#, .NET Framework 4.0, Windows Forms, Windows Communication Foundation, Team Foundation Server, Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle.

positions.title: Junior Developer
positions.description:
Atención Ciudadana:
- Built a module to determine the next person to serve in the queue with C#, Windows Forms, WCF and Oracle, which increased customer service.

Tech Stack: C#, .NET Framework 4.0, Windows Forms, Windows Communication Foundation, Team Foundation Server, Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle.
